verdict.rationale: Airweave's search docs offer more than one retrieval mode. Developers can pick a fast "direct vector search" or an agentic search that "searches with multiple strategies" and navigates entity hierarchies, so retrieval is not limited to one fixed similarity search. However, the pack never mentions metadata filters, keyword or hybrid search modes, or reranking. Bitbucket's branch and file-type filtering applies at sync time, not query time, so it is not credited here. missing for 10: query-time metadata filters, keyword/hybrid search modes, reranking controls, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can steer retrieval with metadata filters, keyword/hybrid search modes, or reranking instead of accepting a single fixed similarity search

citations.quote: Direct vector search. Use when speed is critical (~0.5sec).
It searches with multiple strategies, reads full documents, navigates entity hierarchies (parent/child/sibling), and builds a comprehensive result set.
